name: @amykit/plugin-terminal-conversation
description: The person's terminal as an amy conversation: asks post to stdout, and answers come back as a line or a number.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a workflow should ask its questions in the terminal amy runs in. It mounts the conversation port on stdin and stdout: an ask is printed, and the answer is a line or a number typed back. amy setup mounts it for the setup workflow, so the questions arrive where you typed the command.
